title: Supplementary Works
summary: Supplements to a monograph get the same headings as the original plus headings for topics peculiar to the supplement; supplements limited to one kind of complementary material get the original's headings with an appropriate form subdivision added (--Bibliography, --Maps, --Pictorial works, --Outlines, syllabi, etc., --Problems, exercises, etc., --Examinations, questions, etc., --Tables). Supplements to serials get headings for their own topic. Indexes are covered in H 1670.
validation_rules: A supplement to a monograph generally receives the same headings as the original work, plus headings for topics peculiar to the supplement. (H 2145 sec. 1)

For supplements limited to one type of complementary material, add the appropriate form subdivision to the original's headings, e.g. `--Bibliography`, `--Maps`, `--Pictorial works`, `--Outlines, syllabi, etc.`, `--Problems, exercises, etc.`, `--Examinations, questions, etc.`, `--Tables`. (H 2145 sec. 1)
Supplements to a serial receive headings appropriate to the topic of the supplement. (H 2145 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. Supplements to a monograph
sections.text: To a work that supplements a monograph, generally assign the same headings that were assigned to the original work. Assign additional subject headings as necessary to bring out any topics peculiar to the supplement. For supplements limited to a particular type of complementary material such as bibliographies, maps, plates, study guides, workbooks, tables, etc., modify the subject headings assigned to the original by adding an appropriate form subdivision, for example, --Bibliography; --Maps; --Pictorial works; --Outlines, syllabi, etc.; --Problems, exercises, etc.; --Examinations, questions, etc.; --Tables.

sections.heading: 2. Supplements to a serial
sections.text: For monographic or serial supplements to a serial, assign headings appropriate to the topic of the supplement.

sections.heading: 3. Indexes to individual publications
sections.text: For indexes to individual monographs or serials, see H 1670, sec. 3.d.
